title: skill-lock lockfile
description: Content hashes of agent skills (folders holding a SKILL.md). `skill-lock verify` fails when a skill on disk no longer matches.

$schema.description: Optional link to this schema, for editors.

skills.description: One entry per skill, keyed by its folder path relative to the skills folder, with forward slashes.

additionalProperties.description: sha256 over every file's path and content in the skill folder, sorted; text files use LF line endings and symlinks are hashed as their target path.
